title: Investment & Capital Markets
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El vocabulario de Inversión y Mercados de Capitales te permite entender informes financieros complejos, discutir opciones de financiamiento y participar en reuniones de alto nivel con inversores y analistas.

parts.visual:
Términos Clave de Inversión: 
- Equity (Capital / Acciones / Valor neto): Propiedad en una empresa. 
Ej: The founders own 60% of the company's equity. 
- IPO (Initial Public Offering / Oferta Pública Inicial): Cuando una empresa privada vende acciones al público por primera vez. 
Ej: The tech startup raised $500 million in its IPO. 
- Dividend (Dividendo): Parte de las ganancias de una empresa pagada a los accionistas. 
Ej: The board approved a quarterly dividend of $0.50 per share.
parts.audio: Key Investment Terms. 'Equity' refers to ownership in a company, often represented by shares. For example: The founders own 60% of the company's equity. An 'I P O' or Initial Public Offering is when a private company sells shares to the public for the first time. For example: The tech startup raised $500 million in its I P O. A 'Dividend' is a sum of money paid regularly by a company to its shareholders out of its profits. For example: The board approved a quarterly dividend of $0.50 per share.

parts.visual:
Estrategias y Fondos: 
- Hedge fund (Fondo de cobertura): Fondo de inversión privado que utiliza estrategias agresivas y de alto riesgo. 
Ej: The hedge fund shorted the housing market and made billions. 
- Portfolio (Portafolio / Cartera de inversiones): El conjunto de inversiones de una persona o institución. 
Ej: You should diversify your portfolio to minimize risk. 
- Yield (Rendimiento): Los ingresos generados por una inversión, expresados en porcentaje. 
Ej: Government bonds currently offer a very low yield.
parts.audio: Strategies and Funds. A 'Hedge fund' is a private investment fund that uses aggressive strategies to generate high returns. For example: The hedge fund shorted the housing market and made billions. A 'Portfolio' is a range of investments held by a person or organization. For example: You should diversify your portfolio to minimize risk. 'Yield' refers to the income returned on an investment, usually expressed as an annual percentage. For example: Government bonds currently offer a very low yield.

questions.question: The founders gave away 20% of the company's ____ to venture capitalists. (Capital / Acciones).
questions.explanation: Equity = capital accionarial, propiedad de la empresa.

questions.question: The company became public yesterday through a highly successful ____. (Oferta Pública Inicial).
questions.explanation: IPO = Initial Public Offering (Oferta Pública Inicial).

questions.question: Instead of reinvesting the profits, the company paid a generous ____ to its shareholders. (Dividendo).
questions.explanation: Dividend = dividendo pagado a los accionistas.

questions.question: To manage risk, it is important not to put all your money in one stock; you must diversify your ____. (Cartera).
questions.explanation: Portfolio = cartera o portafolio de inversiones.

questions.question: The annual income returned on an investment, expressed as a percentage, is the ____. (Rendimiento).
questions.explanation: Yield = rendimiento o rentabilidad de una inversión.

questions.question: A private investment partnership that uses aggressive strategies to maximize returns is a ____ fund. (Fondo de cobertura).
questions.explanation: Hedge fund = fondo de cobertura / inversión alternativa.

questions.question: When a market is experiencing a prolonged period of rising prices, it is called a ____ market. (Mercado alcista).
When a market is experiencing falling prices and pessimism, it is a ____ market. (Mercado bajista).
A fixed-income instrument that represents a loan made by an investor to a borrower (typically corporate or governmental) is a ____. (Bono).
An investor who provides capital for a business start-up in exchange for convertible debt or equity is an ____ investor. (Inversor ángel).
questions.explanation: Angel investor = inversor ángel (invierte en etapas tempranas).

questions.question: Firms that invest in startups with high growth potential in exchange for equity are ____ capital firms. (Capital de riesgo).
When an investor borrows shares and sells them, hoping the price will drop so they can buy them back cheaper, they ____ the stock. (Vender en corto).
questions.explanation: Short a stock = vender en corto (apostar a que el precio bajará).

questions.question: A measure of how much the price of an asset fluctuates over time is its ____. (Volatilidad).
The total value of all a company's outstanding shares of stock is its market ____. (Capitalización de mercado).
The ease with which an asset can be converted into cash without affecting its price is called ____. (Liquidez).
Assets that cannot be easily or quickly converted into cash are described as ____. (Ilíquidos).
questions.explanation: Illiquid assets = activos ilíquidos (difíciles de vender rápido, como inmuebles).

questions.question: A financial contract whose value is dependent upon an underlying asset (like a stock or commodity) is a ____. (Derivado).
An investment fund that trades on exchanges and tracks an index is an ____. (Fondo cotizado).
questions.explanation: ETF = Exchange-Traded Fund (fondo cotizado en bolsa).

questions.question: The practice of buying and selling an asset simultaneously in different markets to profit from a price difference is ____. (Arbitraje).
A company's first time offering its shares to the public is the IPO, but a subsequent offering of shares is called a ____ offering. (Oferta secundaria/consecuente).
questions.explanation: Secondary offering (o follow-on offering) = oferta secundaria de acciones.

questions.question: Company ____. (Capital/propiedad con E)
An ____. (Oferta Pública Inicial, siglas)
A quarterly ____. (Dividendo con D)
Investment ____. (Cartera con P)
High ____. (Rendimiento con Y)
A ____ fund. (Fondo de cobertura con H)
A ____ market. (Mercado alcista con B)
A ____ market. (Mercado bajista con B)
Venture ____. (Capital de riesgo con C)
Market ____. (Volatilidad con V)
